notes: Banner 2023 questionnaire: "Government should not perform mass surveillance. This includes utilizing facial recognition technology and license plate readers." Both technologies named and rejected; calls facial recognition an invasion of privacy. Disambiguates her NO on BL2021-961 3rd reading (2022-02-01, 22-14) downward to prohibition.

Banner 2023 questionnaire: "I am generally opposed to building up surveillance infrastructure" - opposes acquisition itself, citing misuse and unintended consequences raised in debate. Chair 2 is excluded by his NO on BL2021-961 3rd reading (2022-02-01, 22-14): he voted against the council-gated framework from the restrictive side.

Banner 2023 questionnaire: "I am against LPRs." Flat opposition to the technology on privacy, misread and data-misuse grounds, naming ICE subpoena of records. Disambiguates her NO on BL2021-961 3rd reading (2022-02-01, 22-14) downward to prohibition.

Banner 2023 questionnaire: "I voted to not have LPRs." He states the meaning of his own NO on BL2021-961 3rd reading (2022-02-01, 22-14) outright - the vote was against having the technology at all, not against the restrictions on it.

Banner 2023 questionnaire: "I am opposed to LPR technology, and facial recognition technology. Both are harmful to the fabric of society." Both technologies named and rejected. Disambiguates her NO on BL2021-961 3rd reading (2022-02-01, 22-14) downward to prohibition.
